notice.directive: Arrange an in-person assessment today. Do not wait for an asynchronous reply.

event.quote: I fell in the kitchen this morning
event.text: Did you fall because you tripped or slipped, or did you suddenly feel dizzy or have a fall without knowing why?
event.why: Syncope, arrhythmia, or stroke preceding a fall suggests different urgent priorities than mechanical fall alone and affects safety assessment for discharge.
